issues.explanation: Chapter 60 ends by placing Liu Bei’s decision into action: he divides forces, marches west, and meets Meng Da, whereas Chapter 61 then returns to an earlier event at Fucheng—the next-day banquet where Pang Tong and Fa Zheng attempt to kill Liu Zhang—before Liu Bei is sent to Jiameng Pass. This reverses the sequence and makes the handoff confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: End Chapter 60 before the second banquet and departure, after Liu Bei’s initial debate with Pang Tong and Fa Zheng. Alternatively, move the banquet-and-rescue episode earlier in Chapter 61 before summarizing Liu Bei’s departure and meeting with Meng Da.
